break_even_contract.reason: headline APR and buying below the pre-subscription spot price do not value the conditional conversion obligation; no complete option-equivalent fair-value quote, execution hedge, or external subsidy was source-proved

family_identity.shared_failure: settlement direction selects the delivered asset or conversion amount so nominal yield is compensation for path and terminal price risk rather than a market-invariant return

discount_buy.settlement_price_at_or_above_knockout: stablecoin principal plus stated APR reward
discount_buy.settlement_price_at_or_below_target: 100 percent of stablecoin principal buys crypto at the target buy price
discount_buy.settlement_price_between_target_and_knoc: 50 percent of stablecoin principal buys crypto at the target buy price and 50 percent is returned

dual_investment.buy_low_downside: when settlement is at or below the target the stablecoin deposit converts to crypto at the target and can immediately be worth less if the market is further below
dual_investment.conditional_conversion: if the target condition is met the deposited asset converts at the target price; otherwise the original asset is returned
dual_investment.sell_high_upside_cap: when settlement is at or above the target the crypto deposit converts to stablecoin at the target and can forgo gains above it

limitations: The current Binance Developer catalog proves the active product and endpoint families but does not expose complete public payoff economics in its catalog summary.
The current Discount Buy payoff text was available through a Binance-origin announcement mirror because the direct logged-out regional product surface redirected away from the product.
No account-specific product list, quote, eligibility, fee, capacity, position, or settlement evidence was accessed.
No claim is made that either product is identical to one standardized exchange option; the terminal result needs only the documented conditional conversion and locked downside or upside exposure.
A user who independently wants a target-price purchase or sale may value the product differently, but that is an inventory objective and market view rather than a situation-independent edge.
prohibited_actions: treating earn either way or high APR language as principal protection or market-neutral profit
calling a target price below current spot a discount without valuing the obligation to buy when settlement is still lower
calling Dual Investment double-sided positions market-neutral when one conditional conversion can still trigger
simulating strike APR or duration grids without a source-proved option-equivalent fair-value identity and frozen out-of-sample decision rule
requesting account quotes or subscribing to either product without explicit read-only or funded authority as applicable
using leverage reinvestment averaging down or an unpriced hedge to manufacture a positive result

retry_policy.reopen_only_for: a newly source-proved principal guarantee external subsidy mispricing versus a complete executable option-equivalent hedge or a materially different payoff identity that creates a positive worst-state after-cost floor
retry_policy.signed_account_access: not justified while the public payoff remains terminal for a market-situation-independent edge search
retry_policy.trading_authority: always separately required for any subscription redemption conversion transfer or hedge

sources.source_limitation: not treated as independent confirmation; retained because the direct Binance announcement link resolved to the current announcement list in the logged-out regional surface
